summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of ROCK AGRI marketing site. All 9 backend pytest tests pass (root, health, inquiry CRUD, validation). Frontend passes all critical checks: Home hero + CTAs, About keywords, Products listing shows 37 total, category filters correct (animal-feed=5, spices=13, oil-seeds=7, beans-pulses=12), Product Detail (turmeric) shows specs + 2 wa.me links, Contact form submits successfully and shows success toast, WhatsApp FAB present on every page with correct wa.me/919913404650 href, mobile menu toggle works.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx performs window.location.href = mailto:... right after successful inquiry POST. This replaces the page URL and on some browsers can interrupt subsequent UI updates. Consider using a hidden anchor click or window.open to open mailto without navigating away from the success state.
server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo and converts back on list. Simpler/cleaner to persist as native datetime and let motor handle serialization.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); lifespan context handler is preferred in current FastAPI.
products.js is a single very large file (>700 lines). Consider splitting by category for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_-prefixed inquiry docs in MongoDB via API during backend & frontend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_inquiries.py covers /api/, /api/health, POST /api/inquiries (valid/minimal/invalid-email/missing fields) and GET /api/inquiries (ordering + _id leak). Frontend testid conventions used: whatsapp-fab, product-card-<slug>, contact-map, contact-address, contact-phone, contact-email, inquiry-form, form-name/email/phone/country/product/message/submit, form-success, form-error, mobile-menu-toggle. Category slugs: animal-feed, spices, oil-seeds, beans-pulses with counts 5/13/7/12. FAB href must remain https://wa.me/919913404650?text=...
